summary: Synaptics Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by ON Semiconductor Corporation (onsemi). Under the agreement, each share of Synaptics common stock will be converted into 1.350 shares of onsemi common stock (stock consideration). The merger consideration is all-stock; no per-share dollar price or premium percentage is stated. The deal is structured as a reverse triangular merger with Synaptics surviving as an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary. Board recommendation and advisors are not named in this excerpt. Regulatory approvals are subject to conditions, with no expected close date provided. Watch for shareholder vote and antitrust clearance for risk-arb spread.
